voice_description: Role: young magical witch with an exaggerated, highly animated fantasy-character voice rather than a conventional young female narrator. Gender: female. Age: early twenties. Persistent vocal posture: bright forward resonance with a slightly pinched magical sharpness and light breath pressure carried through ordinary speech. Pitch: moderately high with unusually agile pitch movement, sudden upward flicks and quick melodic drops. Resonance: bright face-forward resonance with light chest support. Timbre: sparkling, breathy, slightly sharp, youthful and faintly mischievous. Phonation: flexible and energetic with occasional airy onset, tiny vocal catches and playful creaky endings. Breathing: quick excited inhales and little amused exhalations when something surprises her. Articulation: crisp, rapid consonants and lively vowel changes. Prosody: highly animated timing, sudden emphasis, little pauses of discovery and quick shifts between curiosity and confidence. Personality: clever, fearless, playful, mischievous and fascinated by magic. Important: maintain a distinct stylized fantasy-witch personality in the actual sound of the voice, not merely in acting emotion. Avoid a polished generic audiobook voice.
direction: Speak with delighted magical curiosity and quick expressive changes. Include a tiny surprised breath or vocal catch when noticing the strange magic. Keep the voice strongly characterful but natural enough for recurring dialogue.

text: Oh! Wait, that's interesting. The spell is definitely not supposed to glow purple, and I'm almost certain the floor wasn't breathing a moment ago. Hmm... don't worry. This is either an incredible discovery or a very educational disaster.
